headline: Maui County Animal Control Board

meeting.summary: The Animal Control Board voted unanimously to remove past contested case minutes and hearing records from its County web page.
meeting.recap: The Animal Control Board meeting was called to order.[[0:00:31]] All members were present, so the board had a quorum (enough members to act).[[0:02:09]] No one asked to give public testimony, in person or online.[[0:02:45]] The board took up whether to remove past contested case (formal hearing) minutes and hearing records from its County web page.[[0:02:58]] The board secretary said a constituent asked by phone to have these records removed.[[0:03:26]] Corporation Counsel advised the board to discuss and vote on it.[[0:03:35]] The secretary said the board no longer makes minutes for contested cases such as dangerous dog appeals.[[0:05:00]] A written decision describing the hearing and the board's ruling is mailed to all parties.[[0:05:07]] The board's lawyer said contested cases are governed by state law chapter 91, separate from the Sunshine Law.[[0:06:10]] The lawyer recommended removing the past minutes, saying some of the information should not be posted permanently.[[0:06:40]] The chair supported removal, noting that three people had asked to have their cases taken down.[[0:07:37]] A board member moved to remove the minutes.[[0:08:26]] Another member seconded the motion.[[0:08:39]] The motion passed unanimously by voice vote.[[0:08:49]] The meeting was adjourned.[[0:09:46]]
decided: The board voted unanimously to remove past contested case minutes and related hearing records from its County web page.
